old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-k0xp","title":"lichend persists a replay epoch but Gateway ignores it and always starts at epoch 128","description":"P1 security review. rust/lichen-gateway/src/bin/lichend.rs loads/increments/saves safe_epoch, but never passes it to Gateway. Gateway::new in gateway.rs hardcodes SecureStack::from_radio(..., 128, 0). Every daemon restart therefore reuses epoch 128 and sequence numbers from zero despite the persisted counter, enabling link tuple/signature replay and causing peers to reject legitimate restarted traffic. Accept the reserved persisted epoch in the production Gateway constructor, fail closed at epoch 255 instead of continuing/reusing it, and add restart tests proving emitted tuples advance and can never repeat.","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"me@mark.atwood.name","created_at":"2026-08-24T12:23:43.498757Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-08-24T12:23:43.498757Z"}
